title: Event triggering - eval
description: A custom event listener extracts user-provided payload data from the event detail and executes it using eval().
objectives: Inspect the custom event listener on 'app-action'.
Trace how e.detail.command is passed into eval().
Dispatch an event with arbitrary JavaScript.
hints: Use the input box or dispatch from DevTools: window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('app-action', { detail: { command: 'alert(1)' } }))
body:
Custom Event Dispatcher (eval sink)

This page triggers and listens for custom DOM events carrying payload data that is passed to eval().
